songs.title: Tomorrow ain't promised
songs.content:
(Intro – spoken, low in the mix over bass and soft chords)
Yeah…
Just riding…
Thinking ‘bout how it all bends in the end…
(Verse 1)
Streetlights flicker like they remember my name
Bassline walking slow, keeping time with the pain
I ain’t chasing nothing, let the wheel do the talk
Ghosts in the passenger seat still burning that New port
Used to pray for the shine, now the shine feel heavy
Gold on my neck but the heart stay unsteady
She said “You changed,” I said “Baby, that’s growth”
Then I watched her walk out in that camel trench coat
Now it’s just me and the midnight blue
Reverb on my voice like the truth need echo too

(Chorus)
Neon and regret, that’s the color I’m in
Bass keep it stepping while the night cave in
I don’t wanna fight it, I just let it spin
Round and round, till the end begin
Neon and regret, pouring out the glass
Tomorrow ain’t promised, but tonight gon’ last
Low in the seat, let the smoke rise slow
This minor key living all I know

(Verse 2)
Dashboard Jesus still judging my moves
Radio whispering songs I can’t sing in tune
I laugh to myself—man, the irony thick
God gave me bars but won’t fix what I did
Old friends hit my line talking “remember when”
I just send the read receipt, let the silence begin
Money got longer, but the circle got thin
Funny how peace feel a lot like giving in
Guitar cry soft in the background
Like it know every apology I never sent out

(Chorus)
Neon and regret, that’s the color I’m in
Bass keep it stepping while the night cave in
I don’t wanna fight it, I just let it spin
Round and round, till the end begin
Neon and regret, pouring out the glass
Tomorrow ain’t promised, but tonight gon’ last
Low in the seat, let the smoke rise slow
This minor key living all I know

(Instrumental break)
(Bass walks alone for 4 bars, guitar answers with melancholy licks, hi-hats open just a little, letting it breathe)
(Bridge – half-sung, half-spoken, reverb heavy)
I ain’t looking for forgiveness on these avenues
Just a clean stretch of road and a lie that feels true
If I call you tonight, don’t pick up the phone
Some ghosts sound better when they haunt alone
(Final Chorus – softer, almost whispering)
Neon and regret, fading in the rearview
Bass still walking like it got nothing to prove
I don’t wanna fight it, I just let it spin
One more loop, then I’m pulling in
Neon and regret, last drop in the glass
Sun coming up, but the feeling won’t pass
Turn the key off, let the silence creep slow
This minor key living…
All I know.
(Outro – bass fades, one last soft guitar chord rings out with reverb)
Perfect for that smooth, raspy delivery over a walking bass and smoky chords. Hope it feels right when you lay it down.
